features: Function extensions remain in the compiled function scope chain rather than mutating the realm; with-scope taint belongs to the generated executable. Function construction uses the parsing realm, preserving Function.prototype identity.
Special parsing contexts use the shared native context lookup; compileFunction option and callback validation is restored, with correct extension index labels.
limitations: Initial Node v26.10.0 control aborts at native ContextifyFunction::CompileFunction val->IsObject on nullable extension input. Logs are preserved; that crashing fixture is not rerun or published as executable source, and receives no pass credit.

Nullable/proxy extension completeness, callback ownership cycles and last evaluated-context retirement #885 remain unresolved. No live-context filtering/cache flushing/assertion weakening is introduced.
All-platform/Release/ASAN, every memory type and full Bun-suite completion remain unproven.
